_comment: What only the printed timetable for this year can tell you. parse_timetable.py
refuses to run without a file like this, because every value here is read off
the masjid's own board and cannot be derived from the rows.
ah_year_at_jan_1 : the Hijri year on 1 January. The parser moves it on by one
each time Muharram appears, so only the starting value is
spot             : hand-checked days, as (fajr begins, fajr jamaat, zuhr
begins, zuhr jamaat, maghrib, isha jamaat). null means
'whatever the row says' — used where the board dittos.
Three is the minimum: the first day, the last day, and one
in high summer where the times are most extreme. A parser
